quick_skim.title: Recompute or Restore? Host-Tier KV for Multi-Model Agent Workflows on a Static-Graph NPU Serving Stack
quick_skim.abstract: Agent workflows issue dependent model calls that share long context prefixes, so serving them efficiently depends on reusing the key-value (KV) cache of those prefixes. On accelerators that compile model graphs ahead of time, however, the device KV budget is fixed, and prefixes evicted under load must be recomputed. Restoring them from host memory avoids this recomputation, but the transfer occupies the same engine thread as prefill and decode, so its benefit is not guaranteed. In this paper, we study when restoring beats recomputing on a commercial static-graph neural processing unit (NPU) stack (Rebellions ATOM+, vllm-rbln 0.10.2) that serves a Qwen3-8B planner on two cards and a Qwen3-0.6B executor on one. We first show that repeated prefill dominates planner work when default serving collapses: 89.5% of the executed planner prompt tokens had been materialized before. We then build a synchronous host-DRAM tier on the runtime's public KV copy calls, together with a scheduler-aware event model whose predictions are frozen before each test cohort. Experimental results show that the host tier raises workflow service-level objective (SLO) attainment from 22.8% to 100% and from 9.4% to 99.8% in the two tested overload conditions, and endpoint confirmation on two new seeds supports conservative load gains of 11.8% (chain) and 18.2% (fork), while mixed and bursty workloads remain seed-sensitive. The frozen model predicts median and 99th-percentile (P99) latency within its 15% tolerance in all 24 common-load conditions, including the 16-18% P99 increase that the tier causes for fork workflows, but it misorders three policy contrasts and overestimates the benefit of a cheaper store path (11% predicted against 3.1% measured). The trade-off therefore depends on runtime scheduling and transfer cost as well as cache capacity.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该文针对静态图NPU上多模型智能体工作流共享长上下文前缀、设备KV预算固定且驱逐后需重算的问题，研究从主机内存恢复被驱逐前缀是否优于重算。作者在Rebellions ATOM+与vllm-rbln栈上部署Qwen3规划器和执行器，分析恢复传输占用预填充/解码线程的代价。结果表明恢复与重算的优劣取决于负载和前缀特征，为工作流感知的KV缓存调度与驱逐策略提供依据。

quick_skim.title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
quick_skim.abstract: Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and provides a reference sample concurrency to exploit parallelism while limiting recomputation. Trajectory-aware routing and scheduling promote cache reuse while balancing worker load. Under constrained environment capacity, we decouple sample admission from environment execution and introduce Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS), which prioritizes long chains using observed progress to shorten the batch tail. Controlled replay combines actual inference with recorded environment responses and durations for ablations of individual optimizations. Live evaluations with Ling-3.0-Flash and Ling-3.1-Flash on the BFCL, SWE-bench Multilingual, WideSearch, and MCP-Atlas benchmarks demonstrate makespan reductions of 10.4% to 65.0%, while evaluation scores remain aligned. Furthermore, these methods have been successfully applied to training and evaluation workflows for the Ling-3.x model series, accelerating the model-development cycle.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Targets batch makespan for LLM agent tasks alternating inference and environment interaction. It coordinates GPU memory between KV cache and recurrent state and uses trajectory-aware routing and scheduling to promote cache reuse while balancing load.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对LLM智能体批量任务在推理与环境交互间频繁切换导致批处理完工时间高的问题，提出推理-环境协同优化框架。方法包括基于工作负载的资源模型在KV缓存与循环状态之间分配GPU显存，并用轨迹感知路由与调度促进缓存复用、平衡工作节点负载。在环境容量受限时进一步解耦样本准入与执行调度，以提升整体批处理效率。该工作为智能体工作流中的缓存调度与资源协同提供了可复用思路。
